lines: a single isometric 3d clay figure of a factory machine standing idle yet powered on, its indicator light glowing amber while no material passes through it, warm off white matte body with one amber accent plane, resting on its base, plain solid black background, soft even light, soft contact shadow, chalky matte clay finish, no screens dials or gauges, deep shadowed underside for contrast against a pale card
